snippet.title: MotionRec – Release Date Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Switch / PlayStation®5
snippet.description:
Experience the unique mechanic where you "record" and "playback" your movements in this tape recorder themed puzzle action game!

MotionRec  is coming to Nintendo Switch and PlayStation®5 on April 2nd, 2026!

▼Nintendo eShop
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/motionrec-switch/

▼PlayStation Store
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017211

▼PLAYISM Official Site
https://playism.com/en/game/motionrec/

Developer: HANDSUM / Publisher: PLAYISM
